name: Kentucky
source: KRS 141.020(2)(f) (3.5 percent for taxable years from 1 January 2026, read on apps.legislature.ky.gov 2026-10-22), Kentucky DOR 2026 standard deduction announcement (3360), KRS 140.070 and 140.080 (inheritance tax as amended by 2026 Ky. Acts ch. 198); second sources Bloomberg Tax (2026 withholding at 3.5%), TaxSlayer and TaxAct (31110 pension exclusion, 40 age credit)

state_base.note: Kentucky starts from federal adjusted gross (or taxable) income, so 401(k) deferrals, Traditional IRA deposits and HSA deposits stay deductible as on the federal return (confirmed primary: https://apps.legislature.ky.gov/law/statutes/statute.aspx?id=57914, validation run 2, 2026-10-22).

standard_deduction.note: 3360 per return for 2026 (Kentucky DOR). Most married couples file 'married filing separately on a combined return' (status 2 of Form 740), where each spouse takes it, so the joint table holds two (6720); with a flat rate that status gives the same tax as one joint return with both deductions.

exemption_credits.note: Kentucky dropped its personal and dependent credits in 2018; a 40 credit remains for each person aged 65 or older (another 40 if blind, not modelled). The family size tax credit for low incomes is not modelled.

retirement_exclusion.note: Pension, annuity, IRA and 401(k) income is excluded up to 31110 per person (each spouse on a joint return); the law sets no age test (KRS 141.010 retirement income; Schedule P, TaxSlayer). Not modelled: the larger exclusion of Schedule P for service credited before 1998 and the full exclusion of military pensions.

estate_inheritance.note: Kentucky has no estate tax. Inheritance tax (KRS 140.070, read 2026-10-22): Class A (spouse, parents, children, stepchildren, grandchildren, siblings and half siblings, and from deaths in 2026 nephews and nieces) pays nothing; Class C (everyone not in Class A or B) has 500 exempt (KRS 140.080, charged against the lowest brackets) then 6% to 10000, 8% to 20000, 10% to 30000, 12% to 45000, 14% to 60000 and 16% above; 'other' holds Class C. Not modelled: Class B (sons- and daughters-in-law, aunts, uncles, great-grandchildren: 1000 exempt, 4% to 16% in eight bands), the 5% discount for paying within nine months, and exempt transfers (life insurance to a named beneficiary, charities).

social_security.note: Kentucky does not tax Social Security benefits; it is not among the states that tax them in Kiplinger 2026 (https://www.kiplinger.com/taxes/states-that-tax-social-security-benefits) and AARP, as listed in .claude/state/research/state-costs.md. Confirmed primary on https://apps.legislature.ky.gov/law/statutes/statute.aspx?id=57914 (validation run 2, 2026-10-22).

local_income_tax.check_at: Kentucky Department for Local Government occupational license tax rate list; Louisville Metro Revenue Commission and Lexington-Fayette revenue pages
local_income_tax.note: Occupational license taxes of cities, counties and school boards: Louisville/Jefferson County 2.2% (1.45% metro plus 0.75% schools), Lexington-Fayette 2.25%, Bowling Green 1.85%, Owensboro 1.78%, Northern Kentucky counties 0.7% to 1.05%, many rural counties about 1% or none (prosalarytax.com 2026 guide). A population-weighted average of about 1.3% is assumed (an estimate). It taxes wages and net business profits where they are earned, not retirement income or Social Security.

sales_tax.check_at: Kentucky revenue department sales and use tax rate tables
sales_tax.source: Tax Foundation, State and Local Sales Tax Rates, Midyear 2026 (https://taxfoundation.org/data/all/state/2026-sales-tax-rates-midyear/), as of 2026-07-01; groceries and clothing: https://zamp.com/resources/sales-tax-on-groceries and https://zamp.com/blog/sales-tax-on-clothing
sales_tax.note: Rates as fractions; avg_local_rate is the combined less the state rate, at least 0. vehicle_rate is the purchase tax on a car: 0.06 from the state's own source (Kentucky motor vehicle usage tax 6% (https://revenue.ky.gov/Property/Motor-Vehicles/Pages/Motor-Vehicle-Usage-Tax.aspx, validation run 2)). Imported from .claude/state/research/state-costs.csv by .claude/state/scratch/importStateCosts.py. Groceries and clothing: grocery_rate is the state rate on groceries (0.0) plus the average local rate where locals tax them (locals: no); research note: Food exempt; no local sales tax. clothing_taxable is true (research: yes; taxed). Set by hand from .claude/state/research/grocery-tax.csv and clothing-tax.csv (s329).

property_tax.check_at: Census ACS 2024 1-year tables B25090 and B25082 at https://data.census.gov
property_tax.source: Census ACS 2024 1-year (B25090 / B25082) as compiled at https://floridaprobateandfamilylaw.com/blog/effective-property-tax-rates-by-state-2025/
property_tax.note: Effective rate: real-estate taxes paid divided by home value, owner-occupied homes. Senior relief, homestead caps and freezes are not in it (a buyer pays the full rate). Imported from .claude/state/research/state-costs.csv by .claude/state/scratch/importStateCosts.py.

home_insurance.source: Insurify state table for a 300,000 dwelling (https://insurify.com/homeowners-insurance/states/), October 2026
home_insurance.note: Average annual premium for a 300,000 dwelling. Quote averages differ by 20 to 40 percent between publishers, so the model uses it as a ratio between states only. Imported from .claude/state/research/state-costs.csv by .claude/state/scratch/importStateCosts.py.

car_insurance.source: Insurify full coverage, monthly times 12 (https://insurify.com/car-insurance/states/), October 2026
car_insurance.note: Average annual full-coverage premium. Used as a ratio between states only. Imported from .claude/state/research/state-costs.csv by .claude/state/scratch/importStateCosts.py.

car_taxes.check_at: Kentucky motor vehicle registration and vehicle property tax pages
car_taxes.source: WalletHub, 2026's Property Taxes by State, vehicle tax table (https://wallethub.com/edu/t/states-with-the-highest-and-lowest-property-taxes/11585/), read 2026-10-22
car_taxes.note: Annual vehicle tax on a 29100 car (2026 Toyota Camry LE): annual ad valorem (property) tax on vehicles, state and local. One source, so unconfirmed; flat registration and title fees are not in it. Set by hand after .claude/state/scratch/importStateCosts.py (which writes 0); rerunning the importer resets it.

fuel.source: Excise: https://apps.legislature.ky.gov/law/kar/downloads/docs/18213/document.engrossed.pdf (validation run 2, 2026-10-22); price: USGasGauge state-by-year table (AAA data), 2024 annual average
fuel.note: gas_tax_per_gallon is the state excise in dollars, without sales tax on fuel: 0.264 total state tax (0.20 excise, 0.05 supplemental, 0.014 petroleum environmental assurance fee), frozen from 2026-07-01 (103 KAR 43:341E); average_price_per_gallon is the 2024 average pump price (grade unclear, about regular). Set by hand from the primary source in validation run 2, 2026-10-22; importStateCosts.py keeps a hand-set section.

utilities.source: EIA Electric Power Monthly Table 5.6.B, residential price, January to July 2026
utilities.note: Average residential electricity price in dollars per kWh, January to July 2026 (a partial year). Imported from .claude/state/research/state-costs.csv by .claude/state/scratch/importStateCosts.py.

housing.check_at: https://fred.stlouisfed.org (Zillow Home Value Index by state) and https://meric.mo.gov/data/cost-living-data-series
housing.source: Zillow Home Value Index by state via FRED (September 2026); MERIC Cost of Living Data Series housing index (C2ER, US = 100), Q2 2026
housing.note: typical_home_value is the Zillow Home Value Index (all homes, middle tier); cost_index is the MERIC housing cost index (US = 100), used to scale rent after a move. Imported from .claude/state/research/state-costs.csv by .claude/state/scratch/importStateCosts.py.

health_premiums.check_at: https://www.kff.org/affordable-care-act/state-indicator/average-marketplace-premiums-by-metal-tier/, Kentucky insurance department Medigap rate guide and the CMS MA Landscape and Part D files (https://www.cms.gov)
health_premiums.source: KFF Average Marketplace Premiums by Metal Tier 2026 (benchmark silver at 40, times the federal age curve 2.124 for 60); MoneyGeek Medicare Supplement Plan G at 65, 2026; KFF Average Monthly Premium for PDPs, 2024; MedicareSupplement.com analysis of the CMS 2026 MA Landscape files
health_premiums.note: Monthly premiums per person, unsubsidized list prices: aca_60_monthly is the benchmark silver plan at 60 (estimated from the age-40 figure), medigap_g_monthly Plan G at 65, part_d_monthly the enrollment-weighted Part D plan, medicare_advantage_monthly the average Medicare Advantage premium. Null means no usable figure; a move then leaves that premium unchanged. Used as ratios between states only. Imported from .claude/state/research/state-costs.csv and state-costs-2.csv by .claude/state/scratch/importStateCosts.py.

price_indexes.source: MERIC Cost of Living Data Series grocery index (C2ER, US = 100), Q2 2026; BEA Regional Price Parities by state, goods and other services (US = 100), 2024, release of 2026-02-19 via FRED
price_indexes.note: Price levels with US = 100: grocery_index is the MERIC grocery index, bea_goods and bea_services the BEA Regional Price Parities for goods and for services other than rent. Used as ratios between states only. Imported from .claude/state/research/state-costs.csv and state-costs-2.csv by .claude/state/scratch/importStateCosts.py.

long_term_care.source: Genworth / CareScout Cost of Care Survey 2024, Ranked State Data Tables, state medians (https://assets.carescout.com/a41bb6478c/298701.pdf)
long_term_care.note: State median monthly costs: a home health aide, an assisted living facility and a private nursing home room. Stored for reference; the model does not use them. Imported from .claude/state/research/state-costs.csv and state-costs-2.csv by .claude/state/scratch/importStateCosts.py.
